notes.content: [h2]The Last Map | Devlog[/h2][p]Earlier this year, I started developing a two-player cooperative game, and I’m documenting the entire development process in this video series. All episodes have subtitles in English, Portuguese, and Spanish, and starting from episode 8, all episodes are dubbed in English (AI-generated). notes.title: Mary Update 1
notes.content:
[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Restart button on Chapter 3's death screen not working
[*] Not all story texts appear in Chapter 2 (even if not required to progress)
[*] Footstep sound for "Detective Finn" in Chapter 1 missing
[*] Pressing Space after the Chapter 2 intro dialogue still plays the dialogue sound
[*] Enemies clipping into objects they shouldn't
[*] Restarting from the death screen returns to the chapter's start
[/list]

[h3]Fixes / Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shadows on 'Ultra' graphics changed to a less detailed, more realistic version
[*] Story texts in Chapter 2 adjusted (size and position)
[*] Along with fixing footstep sounds, the sound was replaced
[*] Easter eggs added
[*] Graphics improved
[*] Optimization improved for Medium and Low graphics settings (the game now runs better on lower-end PCs with Medium or Low graphics)

[h5]Main Instructions Updated:[/h5]
[list]
[*] "MOVE: WASD" changed to "INTERACT: E"
[*] "LOOK AROUND USING MOUSE" changed to "DON'T FORGET YOUR CLIPBOARD (ALT)"
[*] "ANALYZE CLUES CAREFULLY" added
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Mary News!
notes.content:
Only 11 days left until Mary's release!

Until then, I have some news:
- Soundtracks available on Steam:
 Shortly after Mary's release, the soundtracks used in the game will be made available on Steam.
- Small launch announcement:
 It will be displayed shortly before the game's starting point.

notes.title: DEMO AND GAME RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049092/979216ffb932c5bc209734dedc74280fdba2bea8.png[/img]

- We are currently working on the demo version of the game! The scheduled date for the game's demo is August 6, 2024. And in that time we calculated the time left until the end of development, which would be in the penultimate week of December 2024! It's good to make it clear that it may YES be delayed, but this is the date we plan to release the game.
